visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with shoulder-length black hair, wearing a black blazer and beige top, speaks directly to the camera in a lush green park with trees and a stone-lined pond. (2) A static family photo appears, showing the same woman in casual black clothing smiling alongside two young children in an outdoor urban setting. (3) The woman is seen from behind, dressed in a formal black business suit and carrying a brown leather handbag, walking across a paved city plaza toward distant buildings. (4) Footage from a talent show depicts the woman on a lit stage wearing a bright yellow fringed dress, holding a microphone and singing under vibrant purple and red stage lights. (5) A group shot on a television stage follows, where the woman stands dejectedly among other contestants under a large 'Super Star' graphic background. (6) In a mirrored dance studio, the woman wears a grey and red striped sweater and black leggings, practicing rhythmic choreography alongside an instructor. (7) A POV shot focuses on the woman's feet in white sneakers walking on grey outdoor tiles during rain, creating a somber mood. (8) The woman walks through a modern, glass-walled shopping mall corridor wearing a beige blazer and jeans, looking reflective. (9) A close-up shows a unique loaf of bread shaped and colored like a watermelon, sliced into vibrant yellow triangles with black seeds. (10) A quick montage shows a silver stand mixer blending white dough, followed by a close-up of golden-brown buns topped with green onions and sesame seeds. (11) The woman's hand is shown writing measurements and recipes in a notebook with a maroon pen next to an open cookbook. (12) Several book covers are displayed, including a cookbook titled '麵包機' and a finance book titled '存債致富', with the woman's face on both. (13) A screen recording scrolls through an online bookstore page showing a collection of twelve different books authored by the woman. (14) A screenshot of a social media profile titled '辣媽 Shania' is shown, highlighting a follower count of 410,000. (15) Behind-the-scenes footage shows the woman sitting at a white table posing for a professional photoshoot with large studio lights and reflectors. (16) The video concludes with a professional studio portrait of the woman smiling confidently in a beige suit against a clean grey background.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 那一年我38歲. (2) [Subtitle]: 我是兩個孩子的媽. (3) [Subtitle]: 我離開了數百萬年薪的金融業. (4) [Subtitle]: 只為了完成一個很天真的夢想. (5) [Subtitle]: 我想要成為唱跳歌手. (6) [Subtitle]: 我參加了很多選秀節目. (7) [Subtitle]: 但每一次都被淘汰. (8) [Subtitle]: 那時候我很難過. (9) [Subtitle]: 我花了那麼多時間練唱. (10) [Subtitle]: 還要練跳舞. (11) [Subtitle]: 我連工作都可以不要了. (12) [Subtitle]: 為什麼還是失敗了. (13) [Subtitle]: 是不是這輩子都不可能變成明星了. (14) [Subtitle]: 但那時候我老公跟我講. (15) [Subtitle]: 你真的盡力了. (16) [Subtitle]: 但你在錯的戰場上拚命. (17) [Subtitle]: 你不是很喜歡做麵包嗎. (18) [Subtitle]: 你就繼續做吧. (19) [Subtitle]: 你會被看見. (20) [Subtitle]: 於是 我擦乾眼淚. (21) [Subtitle]: 我花了更多的時間在練習做麵包. (22) [Subtitle]: 寫食譜. (23) [Subtitle]: 沒想到我的食譜幫助了很多人. (24) [Subtitle]: 出版社也找我一起出書. (25) [Subtitle]: 11年後我成為食譜作家. (26) [Subtitle]: 也是財經理財作家. (27) [Subtitle]: 出版了12本書. (28) [Subtitle]: 有40多萬的粉絲. (29) [Subtitle]: 我才明白 失敗不是句點. (30) [Subtitle]: 它是逗點. (31) [Subtitle]: 暫停一下 好讓你轉彎. (32) [Subtitle]: 走到更適合你的地方. (33) [Subtitle]: 我以為成功是可以站在舞台上. (34) [Subtitle]: 但真正的成功 是你在失敗之後. (35) [Subtitle]: 你還願意相信你自己. (36) [Subtitle]: 我沒有成為歌手 但卻活出更閃耀的自己. [Logo]: 辣媽 Shania.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a motivational autobiography of '辣媽 Shania,' documenting her journey from a high-earning finance professional to a failed aspiring singer, and eventually finding her true calling as a successful baking author and finance writer. It aims to inspire viewers by redefining failure as a redirection toward one's genuine passion.
